# Partnering with Databrary {.unnumbered}

As of February 2026, Databrary is currently partnering with 869 institutions globally. 

If you would like to check if your institution is already partnered with Databrary, you can search through the [full list of institutions](https://databrary.org/search?tab=2) on Databrary.

## How to Partner with Databrary {-}

Steps for institutions to partner with Databrary.

### How to Register as an Authorized Organizational Representative {-}

An Authorized Organizational Representative (AOR) is a person granted authority by their Institution to sign the Databrary Access Agreement on behalf of the Institution and thereby bind the Institution to the terms of the Databary Access Agreement.

Steps to register as an AOR.
